name: December
title: Where to go on holiday in December
intro: Whether you want Christmas on a beach or a white Christmas with reindeer, December has plenty of choice. Here's where's at its best this month.
seo_title: Where to go on holiday in December: Christmas sun and snow

faqs.question: Where is hot at Christmas?
faqs.answer: The Caribbean (Barbados, Cancún), the Maldives, Sri Lanka, Kerala, Thailand, Dubai and Oman are warm and mostly dry. Cape Town, Mauritius and Sydney are in summer. Tenerife is the warmest place within about four and a half hours of the UK.

faqs.question: Where can we have a white Christmas?
faqs.answer: Rovaniemi in Finnish Lapland is the home of Santa Claus Village, with snow, reindeer and husky rides. Whistler has its ski season under way by Christmas.

faqs.question: Is it worth going away at Christmas?
faqs.answer: It's the most expensive week of the year to travel, so book as early as you can. Going in early December or just after New Year is often much cheaper for the same weather.
